rules: Pick the first task whose status is todo and whose depends_on tasks all pass.
Skip tasks with human set to true; set them to blocked and state in evidence what the person must do.
Set status to in_progress and owner to your agent name before starting.
Change only status, owner, passes, and evidence fields.
Set passes to true only after every acceptance item is verified.
Put the verification command output summary in evidence.
Never edit, remove, or weaken acceptance items without human approval.
Set status to blocked and explain in evidence when a dependency or human action is missing.
Use the model and skill named on the task.
Tasks with human set to true need a person at this computer.
Build new UI only under src/features/; never extend the proof-of-concept screens in src/poc/PocApp.tsx.
Mark the task done in tasks/prd.json inside the same pull request that completes it.

tasks.title: Stable DeviceId, server logout, and failed stop reports
acceptance: DeviceId is derived from a persisted install id, server id, and user id
Logout calls POST /Sessions/Logout

tasks.evidence:
pnpm check, pnpm test:e2e, cargo clippy pass (100 vitest tests).
DeviceId = SHA-256(installId:serverId:username.toLowerCase()), install id persisted at localStorage fluster.installId; username stands in for user id because login needs the DeviceId before the user id exists.
logout() POSTs /Sessions/Logout with header auth and clears local state even on failure; reportStopped sends Failed: true after error events, error endings, and error-then-retry. Review notes: DeviceId uses the username, not the user id, because AuthenticateByName needs it before a user id exists (acceptance wording pending human confirmation). Gateway logout POSTs /Sessions/Logout and is tested, but the proof-of-concept UI has no sign-out after login, so it is not reachable until the new sign-in feature (P3-02). Failed is true only for error endings and retries.

tasks.title: Send stopped reports reliably

tasks.evidence: Pre-fix: pnpm test -- playstate-reporter coordinator -> 3 failed | 111 passed; live-signal test 'expected true to be false' (stopped ran with the aborted drain signal); own-timeout and launch-failure tests 'expected vi.fn() to be called with arguments' (no stopped report).
